notes: IMPORTANT NEGATIVE / ANTI-ENTRY. CVE-2026-51297 (claimed jsonBlobEdit) and CVE-2026-51296 (claimed jsonRemoveFunc), plus CVE-2026-51300 (sqlite3ExprDelete), CVE-2026-51302 (exprComputeOperands), CVE-2026-51303 (ExprListDelete) and CVE-2026-51304 (pOrderBy->nExpr) are FABRICATED: the cited code does not exist in the cited versions and the published PoCs do not crash. sqlite.org lists all six under 'Not a bug in SQLite'. Recorded so this survey is not later 'completed' by someone adding them. Beyond CVE-2024-0232 I found NO further memory-safety CVE for the JSON parser in the 264-record NVD dump, and in particular NONE for the JSONB binary format added in 3.45.0 -- though JSONB is a corrupt-blob attack surface and I did not exhaustively search the forum, so treat that as un-searched rather than clean. JSON1 required -DSQLITE_ENABLE_JSON1 before 3.38.0; since 3.38.0 (2022-02-22) the JSON functions are BUILT IN BY DEFAULT and must be removed with -DSQLITE_OMIT_JSON. Our Capstone build passes -DSQLITE_OMIT_JSON=1 (build-sqlite-capstone.sh:176), so the JSON parser is NOT present in our binary.
